INSERT INTO contract_stats (
  region_code, classifier_type, classifier_code,
  period_month, contracts_count, total_sum, avg_price, stddev_price,
  unique_suppliers, unique_customers
)
SELECT
  c.region_code,
  'ktru'::varchar                                AS classifier_type,
  k.code                                         AS classifier_code,
  DATE_TRUNC('month', c.published_at)::date      AS period_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.reg_num)                      AS contracts_count,
  SUM(c.price)                                   AS total_sum,
  AVG(c.price)                                   AS avg_price,
  STDDEV(c.price)                                AS stddev_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.inn)                          AS unique_suppliers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer)                     AS unique_customers
FROM contracts c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.ktru) AS k(code)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.suppliers) AS s(inn)
WHERE c.region_code IS NOT NULL
  AND c.published_at IS NOT NULL
  AND array_length(c.ktru, 1) > 0
GROUP BY c.region_code, k.code, DATE_TRUNC('month', c.published_at)
ON CONFLICT (region_code, classifier_type, classifier_code, period_month)
DO UPDATE SET
  contracts_count  = EXCLUDED.contracts_count,
  total_sum        = EXCLUDED.total_sum,
  avg_price        = EXCLUDED.avg_price,
  stddev_price     = EXCLUDED.stddev_price,
  unique_suppliers = EXCLUDED.unique_suppliers,
  unique_customers = EXCLUDED.unique_customers,
  refreshed_at     = NOW();

INSERT INTO contract_stats (
  region_code, classifier_type, classifier_code,
  period_month, contracts_count, total_sum, avg_price, stddev_price,
  unique_suppliers, unique_customers
)
SELECT
  c.region_code,
  'okpd2'::varchar                               AS classifier_type,
  o.code                                         AS classifier_code,
  DATE_TRUNC('month', c.published_at)::date      AS period_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.reg_num)                      AS contracts_count,
  SUM(c.price)                                   AS total_sum,
  AVG(c.price)                                   AS avg_price,
  STDDEV(c.price)                                AS stddev_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.inn)                          AS unique_suppliers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer)                     AS unique_customers
FROM contracts c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.okpd2) AS o(code)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.suppliers) AS s(inn)
WHERE c.region_code IS NOT NULL
  AND c.published_at IS NOT NULL
  AND array_length(c.okpd2, 1) > 0
GROUP BY c.region_code, o.code, DATE_TRUNC('month', c.published_at)
ON CONFLICT (region_code, classifier_type, classifier_code, period_month)
DO UPDATE SET
  contracts_count  = EXCLUDED.contracts_count,
  total_sum        = EXCLUDED.total_sum,
  avg_price        = EXCLUDED.avg_price,
  stddev_price     = EXCLUDED.stddev_price,
  unique_suppliers = EXCLUDED.unique_suppliers,
  unique_customers = EXCLUDED.unique_customers,
  refreshed_at     = NOW();

SELECT
  NOW()::date::text        AS refreshed_at,
  region_code::text        AS region_code,
  classifier_type          AS type,
  classifier_code          AS code,
  period_month::text       AS period_month,
  contracts_count::text    AS contracts_count,
  COALESCE(total_sum, 0)::numeric(20,2)::text AS total_sum,
  COALESCE(avg_price, 0)::numeric(20,2)::text AS avg_price,
  unique_suppliers::text   AS unique_suppliers
FROM contract_stats
WHERE contracts_count >= 2
ORDER BY total_sum DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50;
